entities.name: Cathedral Basilica of St. Lawrence, Santa Cruz de la Sierra
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Cathedral Basilica of St. Lawrence, also called Santa Cruz de la Sierra Cathedral, is the main Catholic church in the city of Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia. It is located in the city center, opposite the 24 de Septiembre Square.
